summary: Build practical gender responsive budgeting skills with applied analysis, costing, dashboards, and reporting. Enrol in the five-day course.
lede: Gender-responsive budgeting links gender analysis to public spending decisions across the budget cycle. It is designed for budget officers, programme managers, gender advisers and policy analysts who need to connect allocations with gender equality outcomes. Participants assess expenditure incidence, develop gender-sensitive costings and indicators, and prepare a Gender Budget Statement while monitoring budget execution.
audienceIntro: Gender responsive budgeting is suited to professionals who influence public resource allocation, programme design, financial oversight, or equality reporting. The course supports intermediate and advanced learners who already work with budgets, policies, programmes, or performance information.
prerequisites: You should have working experience with public budgets, programme planning, policy analysis, financial reporting, or gender equality initiatives. No programming is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets is useful, while advanced concepts such as automated data preparation and AI-assisted analysis remain at an operational and conceptual level. Participants should bring a laptop capable of using spreadsheet software.
